removed_lines: November Short-Term Pledge The month of November offers a special opportunity to make a small sacrifice in honour of the Sacred Heart of Jesus.
We invite parishioners and friends to consider taking a Short-Term Pledge throughout November.
Pioneer Offering - "I promise, in hon our of the Sacred Heart of Jesus, and with the help of the Blessed Virgin Mary, to abstain from all intoxicating substances until the end of November.
Please consider joining with others in prayer, sacrifice and support for those affected by addiction.
Talk: The Second World War through Jesuit Archives Join us in the Belfast Jesuit Centre on

Thursday 12th November at 7.00pm, for a fascinating illustrated talk by Damien Burke, Archivist of the Irish Jesuit Province and co-editor of The Second World War through Jesuit Archives: The Case of Europe (1939–1945).
Drawing on letters, diaries and archival records from across Europe, this illustrated talk explores the human experience of war through stories of faith, service and resilience.
All are welcome. Light refreshments provided.
